name: get_task
description: Get task details and up to 10 recent activities, with total activity count. Use list_task_updates to read older activities. Long text is explicitly truncated.

task.description: the task to fetch: its MOM-label or id

name: list_members
description: List the members of your workspace (name, email, role) so you can pick an assignee. Returns a bounded page; follow the returned cursor with the same filters for more results. Long text is explicitly truncated.

limit.description: maximum items per page; default 20, maximum 100; byte limits may return fewer

cursor.description: opaque next-page cursor from the previous response; keep the same tool and filters

name: list_milestones
description: List milestones in your workspace, optionally filtered by project. Returns a bounded page; follow the returned cursor with the same filters for more results. Long text is explicitly truncated.

project.description: filter by project: its PRJ-label, exact name, or id

limit.description: maximum items per page; default 20, maximum 100; byte limits may return fewer

cursor.description: opaque next-page cursor from the previous response; keep the same tool and filters

name: list_projects
description: List the projects in your workspace (PRJ-label, name, status). Use this to find the project to create a task in. Returns a bounded page; follow the returned cursor with the same filters for more results. Long text is explicitly truncated.

limit.description: maximum items per page; default 20, maximum 100; byte limits may return fewer

cursor.description: opaque next-page cursor from the previous response; keep the same tool and filters

name: list_tasks
description: List tasks in your workspace, optionally filtered by project, assignee, or status. Use assignee "me" for your own tasks. Returns a bounded page; follow the returned cursor with the same filters for more results. Long text is explicitly truncated.

project.description: filter by project: its PRJ-label, name, or id

assignee.description: filter by assignee: me, a member name, or an email

status.description: filter by status: backlog, todo, in_progress, done, or cancelled

limit.description: maximum items per page; default 20, maximum 100; byte limits may return fewer

cursor.description: opaque next-page cursor from the previous response; keep the same tool and filters

name: list_tasks_v2
description: List tasks with explicit unassigned filtering and validated status. Prefer this tool for new calls; list_tasks retains its legacy filter behavior. Returns a bounded page; follow the returned cursor with the same filters for more results. Long text is explicitly truncated.

project.description: filter by project: its PRJ-label, name, or id

assignee.description: filter by assignee: me, member UUID, name, or email; none/unassign/unassigned means unassigned only. Omit or leave blank for all assignees. Whitespace is trimmed and matching is case-insensitive.

status.description: filter by status: backlog, todo, in_progress, done, or cancelled. Whitespace is trimmed and matching is case-insensitive. Omit for all statuses; blank or unknown values return a tool error.

limit.description: maximum items per page; default 20, maximum 100; byte limits may return fewer

cursor.description: opaque next-page cursor from the previous response; keep the same tool and filters

name: list_task_updates
description: Read task activities (comments and progress updates), newest first. Follow the returned cursor with the same task reference to read older activities. Returns a bounded page; follow the returned cursor with the same filters for more results. Long text is explicitly truncated.

task.description: the task MOM-label or id; keep the same reference when following a cursor

limit.description: maximum items per page; default 20, maximum 100; byte limits may return fewer

cursor.description: opaque next-page cursor from the previous response; keep the same tool and filters
